_note: GTA VI game updates (title updates), newest first. Read Nov 24, 2026 ~05:15-05:30 UTC: Rockstar Support's 'Grand Theft Auto VI Launch Updates' page in Chrome on the Mac (read-only), and press pages via WebSearch/WebFetch (no billed tools). Rockstar publishes the fix list only; version numbers and download sizes come from named outlets, which mostly credit community trackers (PlayStation Game Size, Tex2) that read the console stores. Status per field: 'confirmed' = Rockstar or PlayStation/Xbox itself; 'agree' = two or more publishers state the same, each with its own 'claims' note; 'disagree' = publishers differ (all figures shown); 'single' = one publisher only. Never add leaked or datamined patch contents. 'versions' keys must match 'platforms'. Fix 'tool' links point at our own pages only.

size.text: About 604 MB on PS5 and 1.6 GB on Xbox Series X|S. Rockstar lists no download sizes.

claims.playerone_patch1: about 604 MB (PS5), 1.6 GB (Xbox), per Game Rant

fixes.text: Several issues that made the game crash.
The weather not changing for long stretches.
Phone calls not triggering, including calls that move the story on or unlock missions.
Being unable to lose your Wanted Level.
Being unable to use the deadlift bar at the Gym.
Partners not handing over bags, so you could not sell them to fences.

extra.text: Shacknews and PC Guide reprint the same seven fixes and Vice summarizes them; all three link to Rockstar Support.

claims.vice_patch1: phone call, autosave and crash fixes, links Rockstar's launch update notes
claims.pcguide_patch1: seven fixes, credited to Rockstar Games Support

extra.text: Rockstar has not said when the next update will arrive or which missions the phone-call bug affected.

coverage.text: Coverage on Nov 24: 3 game updates since Nov 13, two before launch and one after. Rockstar published patch notes only for the Nov 23 update.

independence.text: Version numbers and sizes come from outlets that mostly credit the same community trackers reading the PlayStation and Xbox stores (PlayStation Game Size, Tex2), so "Guides agree" means two named publishers state it, not that Rockstar confirmed it. Sizes are download sizes and can differ a little by region.
